badge: GA4 BOOKING EVENT CLEAN FOR A FULL WEEK

meta: Meta spend rose from $4,874 to $5,799 across the market and schedules rose from 95 to 143, so the account-level picture improved. The detail is less even.

Aqua NYC is where the money moved. Spend went from $1,810 to $2,869 and $1,158 of the increase sits in CRKLR - Halloween Campaign - LPV, a landing-page-view objective that recorded no schedules at all. The two converting campaigns, Prospecting and Remarketing, delivered 42 and 24 schedules for $1,063 and $559. Account clicks went from 5,321 to 17,409 and reported landing page views from 3,174 to 12,453, while GA4 sessions rose only 7,244 to 8,208, so the Meta-reported traffic is not arriving as measured sessions.

Hutong Miami is the clean improvement: spend flat at $1,632 and schedules up from 22 to 52, a cost per schedule of $31.4 against $75.1. Hutong NYC also improved, $1,298 for 25 schedules against $1,410 for 14.
google: Google spend across the market rose from $2,379 to $3,848, up 61.7 per cent, and booking conversions from 48.0 to 68.3.

Hutong NYC accounts for most of the increase: $1,166 to $2,150. Search > Midtown alone took $998 and returned 3 booking conversions, about $333 each, while Search > Brand returned 16 for $290 and Search > Special Events 4 for $586. The account cost per booking is $66.6 against a poor threshold of $30.

Aqua NYC ran $896 for 25.0 booking conversions, $35.9 each, improving on $43.6 last week. Hutong Miami ran $802 for 11.0, $72.9 each. Prior-week figures are re-pulled every run because Google conversions settle upward: Hutong NYC's W42 moved from 16.0 as published to 26.0.
ga4: The booking event is clean for a full week. It fired on all seven days at all three properties and GA4 create-path bookings run at 1.44, 1.02 and 0.98 times SevenRooms website booking rows at Aqua NYC, Hutong NYC and Hutong Miami.

Those ratios sit on an unsettled denominator. SevenRooms website covers recomputed a week later came back 5 to 9 per cent lower, so the settled-equivalent ratios are about 1.53, 1.09 and 1.04 against pre-break norms of 1.59 to 1.70, 1.12 to 1.15 and 1.22 to 1.29.
Hutong Miami is the one to watch: below its own norm for a second week. Aqua NYC and Hutong NYC are recording normally.
